prompt_text: I need a personal injury lawyer in Phoenix after a car accident. Which specific law firms should I call, and why?
q1_prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Phoenix for a car accident case?
answer_verbatim:
I can do that — I just need a little more information so I give you the best, targeted recommendations.

Quick questions:
- What ZIP code or neighborhood in Phoenix are you in (so I can prioritize nearby firms)?  
- How severe were the injuries (minor injuries vs hospitalization/long-term disability)?  
- Do you suspect disputed fault or multiple liable parties?  
- Do you prefer a large firm with lots of resources or a smaller local boutique firm that will give you more personal attention?  
- Any language needs (Spanish or other)?

If you want immediate action right now, here’s a short plan and what to call, even before I provide firm names:

Immediate steps to take now
- Get any necessary medical care and preserve records.  
- Take photos of vehicles, injuries, scene and gather witness info.  
- Do NOT sign statements or accept recorded statements from the other driver’s insurer without an attorney.  
- Report the crash to your insurer (give facts, don’t assign blame).  
- Preserve phone records, dashcam footage, traffic cam times if available.

Who to call (right away)
- Arizona State Bar Lawyer Referral Service — they can give you vetted PI attorneys in Phoenix.  
- The Maricopa County Bar Association referral service (for local recommendations).  
(If you want, I can list phone numbers and direct links once you confirm you want them.)

How I’ll choose which law firms to recommend
- Experience handling car-accident claims with injuries similar to yours (medical bills, lost wages, permanent impairment).  
- Trial experience and verdicts/settlements in Phoenix courts (shows willingness to litigate if necessary).  
- Contingency-fee representation (no upfront fee; attorney paid from recovery).  
- Strong client reviews and peer ratings (AV Preeminent, Martindale-Hubbell, Avvo).  
- Local courtroom reputation and relationships with medical experts and accident reconstructionists.  
- Clear communication and availability.

What I can do next for you
- If you give your ZIP and the answers above I’ll provide 6–8 specific Phoenix-area personal injury firms (names, brief reason to call each, what they specialize in, and suggested questions to ask on first call).  
- Or I can give a quick shortlist (2–3) now based on whether you prefer big-firm resources or local boutique attention.

Which would you prefer?
